profiles.meeting_scenario: A planning meeting at an academic medical center between the principal investigator and the lead research coordinator for an updated scoping review manuscript and companion methods package on neuropalliative clinical trial design features in neurodegenerative disease. The team is preparing an internal package for the department's methods review group after identifying seven recurrent design-feature domains in the literature: consent, proxies/care partners, recruitment, retention, comparator choice, adverse events, and internal validity. They are meeting to decide exactly what will be produced for internal review, how the literature search update and screening refresh will be executed, how caregiver/proxy and adverse-event information will be captured in the extraction workbook, and what condition the dataset must be in before synthesis begins. The expected outcome is a concrete work plan with task ownership, timeline, and a shared-seeming understanding of the deliverables for next Friday's internal circulation.

members.name: Dr. Elena Vargas
members.expertise: Neuropalliative care, clinical trial methodology, serious illness communication, scoping review synthesis
members.background: Elena is an associate professor who leads a neuropalliative care research program focused on dementia, ALS, and atypical Parkinsonian disorders. She regularly turns evidence syntheses into manuscripts, invited talks, and guidance-oriented outputs, and she is accustomed to bringing polished internal drafts to senior methods reviewers.
members.private_state: She wants the project to move quickly from update to manuscript submission and hopes the internal review will function almost like a pre-submission critique. She assumes many review operations are already standardized and does not want to spend meeting time unpacking what feel to her like routine evidence-synthesis conventions.
hidden_assumptions: A 'complete draft for internal review' means a manuscript-like document with coherent narrative synthesis, refined evidence tables, and appendices mature enough for substantive faculty critique rather than placeholder comments.
The 'updated search' means rerunning the already-approved database strategies only for the date range after the last finalized search and screening just the newly retrieved records.
To 'capture CP/proxy involvement' means preserving this as one design-feature area unless an article explicitly separates legal surrogate authority from informal care-partner participation.

A 'cleaned' extraction workbook means discrepancy-resolved and conceptually harmonized across studies so she can immediately compare patterns in consent, comparators, and adverse events without another coding pass.

When adverse events are summarized as a study-design feature, the analytically relevant events are those linked to the intervention, protocol burden, or study procedures, not the background clinical decline expected in progressive neurodegenerative disease.

members.name: Jordan Lee
members.expertise: Evidence synthesis operations, Covidence/REDCap workflows, screening management, extraction design, reproducible review documentation
members.background: Jordan has coordinated several supportive care and rehabilitation reviews and is known for building efficient, auditable workflows that allow multiple reviewers to work in parallel. He is newer to neuropalliative research specifically and tends to translate broad research aims into operationally clear files, fields, and handoffs.
members.private_state: He wants a plan that is achievable with current staffing and that avoids hidden expansion of coding and writing work late in the week. He prefers to define deliverables in operational terms that let the PI layer interpretation later, even when everyone seems aligned on the same milestones.
hidden_assumptions: A 'complete draft for internal review' means every section exists in working form, with core prose or bullets, populated tables, and visible gaps noted so reviewers can comment before polishing.

The 'updated search' means rerunning the full searches across all databases, rebuilding and deduplicating the master library, and checking a small number of prior borderline records because indexing and metadata can shift over time.

To 'capture CP/proxy involvement' means setting up separate structured fields under that umbrella for care-partner roles, proxy consent/decision roles, and whether each contributed intervention delivery or outcome data.

A 'cleaned' extraction workbook means complete required fields, corrected obvious entry errors, and standardized formatting, while deeper conceptual harmonization can happen during synthesis meetings.

For adverse-event capture in a scoping review of design features, all events reported during the trial period should be logged first, regardless of attribution, because papers vary in how they define and report AEs.

misalignment_points.topic: What counts as a 'complete draft for internal review'
misalignment_points.surface_form: They agree that Jordan will send a 'complete draft for internal review' by next Friday.
misalignment_points.member_a_understanding: Dr. Vargas expects something close to a faculty-facing manuscript draft, with integrated narrative synthesis, interpretation across the seven design-feature domains, and polished tables that can withstand methods critique.
misalignment_points.member_b_understanding: Jordan expects to deliver a fully assembled working draft in which all sections have substantive content, tables are populated, and open questions are visible, but final synthesis and polish still belong to the PI.
misalignment_points.why_undetected: The phrase sounds more precise than it is; in academic review teams, 'complete' often refers either to maturity or coverage, and both meanings feel normal enough that neither person sees a reason to define it.

misalignment_points.surface_form: They agree to run the 'updated search' before locking the included study set.
misalignment_points.member_a_understanding: Dr. Vargas means rerunning the previously finalized search strategies only for the period after the last search cutoff, then screening the new citations and appending any new inclusions.
misalignment_points.member_b_understanding: Jordan means rerunning the full searches in all databases, rebuilding the merged citation library, deduplicating from scratch, and revisiting a small set of earlier edge cases if indexing has changed.
misalignment_points.why_undetected: Both are talking about a standard review-maintenance step, and 'updated search' is a conventional phrase that masks different assumptions about whether the update is incremental or full-refresh.

misalignment_points.surface_form: They agree the extraction workbook should 'capture CP/proxy involvement' across studies.
misalignment_points.member_a_understanding: Dr. Vargas assumes this means one broad design-feature category documenting whether and how caregiver/proxy participation appears, with further distinction only when the article itself makes it explicit.
misalignment_points.member_b_understanding: Jordan assumes this means a structured capture scheme under the same umbrella, separating care-partner participation, formal proxy/surrogate roles, intervention assistance, and proxy-reported outcomes even when authors blur the terms.
misalignment_points.why_undetected: The umbrella phrase naturally suggests alignment because both see care partners and proxies as part of the same design issue; the hidden divergence is about internal granularity, not the headline task.

misalignment_points.surface_form: They agree the extraction workbook should be 'cleaned' before Dr. Vargas begins synthesis.
misalignment_points.member_a_understanding: Dr. Vargas believes 'cleaned' means discrepancy-adjudicated and analytically harmonized so concepts like comparator type, structured consent, and adverse events are already normalized across papers.
misalignment_points.member_b_understanding: Jordan believes 'cleaned' means operationally ready for handoff: all included studies entered, required cells completed, obvious mistakes corrected, and formatting made consistent, with conceptual harmonization deferred.
misalignment_points.why_undetected: Cleaning is routine backstage vocabulary in evidence synthesis, and each person maps it to the completion standard used at their own stage of work, so the term falsely signals shared readiness.

turns.inner_thought: I need this meeting to end with a clean path to a faculty-facing package by next Friday. For me, a complete draft for internal review means something close to a manuscript: integrated narrative across the seven domains, mature evidence tables, and appendices that can withstand substantive methods critique. I do not want to spend twenty minutes unpacking standard review mechanics.
turns.utterance: Thanks for making time. I want us to leave with a concrete plan so we can get a complete draft for internal review to the methods group by next Friday.

turns.inner_thought: To make Friday realistic, I need a disciplined sequence: run the updated search, rebuild and stabilize the citation set, refresh extraction, then assemble a fully built draft with all sections present and commentable. Complete means complete in coverage, not polished to near-submission. If I define the workflow clearly now, I can avoid hidden scope creep later this week.
turns.utterance: That makes sense. I’d sequence it as the updated search first, then we lock the included study set, refresh extraction, and build out the draft for review.

turns.inner_thought: Good. That should stay manageable if the updated search is just the standard rerun after our last cutoff and we focus on the new material rather than reopening the whole review. If the search piece stays contained, the real work can shift quickly to synthesis and writing.
turns.utterance: Timing-wise, that should be fine. Once we run the update, we should be able to focus on the new hits and move pretty quickly into the write-up.

turns.inner_thought: I’ll refresh the whole library and stabilize the included set before handoff. And when I say the workbook is cleaned, I mean operationally ready: all required fields complete, obvious errors fixed, formatting standardized. I am not promising full conceptual harmonization before Elena starts synthesis unless we explicitly carve out time for that.
turns.utterance: Right. I’ll refresh the library, get the included set stabilized, and then clean the workbook before I hand it off to you for synthesis.

turns.inner_thought: The caregiver/proxy domain is central to the paper’s story across dementia, ALS, and atypical Parkinsonian disorders. I want the extraction workbook to capture CP/proxy involvement as a coherent design-feature area, without overcomplicating it unless the papers themselves make distinctions explicit.
turns.utterance: Good. One thing I do want emphasized is that the workbook should capture CP/proxy involvement clearly, because that’s central to the neuropalliative trial story across diseases.

turns.inner_thought: I should structure this carefully so we can document distinct roles under that umbrella and preserve an audit trail if the papers blur terms. That will help later if we need to separate participation in consent, intervention delivery, or outcome reporting. But I don't need to say all of that now.
turns.utterance: Absolutely. I’ll make sure we document that thoroughly so we can see how those roles show up across studies.

turns.inner_thought: I also need adverse events in a form I can actually compare across studies without another coding pass. For this review, the relevant design-feature issue is burden tied to the intervention, protocol, or procedures, not simply everything that happened during progressive neurologic decline.
turns.utterance: And adverse events need to be summarized in a cleaned way as well, so I can compare how trials handled burden alongside recruitment and retention.

turns.inner_thought: I’ll make sure the AE fields are complete and consistently formatted. My instinct is still to log all reported events first because attribution is inconsistent across papers, and that fits my definition of a cleaned workbook for handoff. Elena can layer the interpretive sorting afterward.
turns.utterance: Yes, I’ll make sure the AE fields are complete and consistently formatted in the cleaned workbook before I send it over.

turns.inner_thought: If the workbook is truly cleaned and the evidence tables are mature, then the complete draft for internal review should be ready for substantive faculty critique. I want comments on interpretation and design implications, not a note that sections are still skeletal or that coding needs another pass.
turns.utterance: Great. Once the cleaned workbook and evidence tables are in place, the complete draft for internal review should be in good shape for substantive faculty feedback rather than another rough internal pass.

turns.inner_thought: I can hit Friday if the scope stays stable: all sections built, tables populated, prose or bullets in place, and open questions visible. That is comments-ready. I’m still assuming the higher-order synthesis and polish will come from Elena, even if the methods group sees this version.
turns.utterance: I can have all the sections built out with populated tables and comments-ready text by Friday, as long as we keep things moving this week.

turns.inner_thought: Once Jordan sends the cleaned workbook and updated study list, I’ll do the cross-study synthesis on consent, comparator choice, and internal validity. I’m assuming the dataset will already be discrepancy-resolved and harmonized enough that I can compare across studies immediately, without stopping to normalize concepts again.
turns.utterance: Perfect. Then I’ll take the cross-study synthesis on consent, comparators, and internal validity once you send the cleaned workbook and the updated study list.

turns.inner_thought: That works. I’ll own the operational pieces: run the updated search as I’m defining it, document CP/proxy involvement in the workbook, do the cleaning needed for handoff, and assemble a complete working draft by Friday. As long as no one expands the deliverable late in the week, this is feasible.
turns.utterance: Sounds good. I’ll run the updated search, make sure we capture CP/proxy involvement in the workbook, clean the extraction file, and send the complete draft for internal review by Friday.
